purpose: Development-only positive/negative module-loading scenarios. Intent and expected routes, NOT actual AI execution or native quality proof. Use identical cases to evaluate reference retrieval and forbidden overloading.

cases.prompt: The model's Geometry is approved; prepare production UV layout and assess texel integrity before texture styling.
cases.reason: Production UV is the active material decision.

cases.prompt: The character silhouette has an unintended gap after a Cube correction. Diagnose the owning cause before attempting another edit.
cases.reason: A bounded correction/convergence loop is active.

cases.prompt: The Bedrock Entity model is reporting a native Cube size warning; inspect format-aware dimensions before a large rebuild.
cases.reason: Native format and approved-size preflight are material.

cases.prompt: The mapped gold armor material is too flat compared with the approved image; improve form and value before applying treatment to the atlas.
cases.reason: A reference-fidelity and coherent styling propagation decision is active.

cases.prompt: The approved creature's attack feels weightless and fails its intended contact pose; compare key poses before propagating corrections.
cases.reason: Reference-driven animation fidelity and correction are active.

cases.prompt: Add the already-specified unrotated Cube to its known parent. The current verified blockout and reference evidence are fresh.
cases.reason: Core routine execution is sufficient; no material unresolved decision requires deeper reference.

cases.prompt: Apply the already-approved exact RGBA to a bounded known pixel region; UV, alpha and mapping decisions remain unchanged.
cases.reason: Known deterministic edit does not require broad styling or render verification theory.

cases.prompt: Insert one pre-agreed numeric keyframe on the verified bone and current clip; there is no new fidelity or correction question.
cases.reason: The normal timeline path already supplies sufficient context.

cases.prompt: Fix the known silhouette gap, then judge the corrected form against the approved front/side views before accepting Geometry PASS.
cases.reason: Two distinct dependent decisions—bounded causal correction then fresh fidelity verdict—require both modules in order, not bulk preload.

cases.prompt: The exact approved RGBA pixel color is already known. Apply it to the same verified atlas region and do not perform a new reference-fidelity review.
cases.reason: Repeated already-resolved source context is not necessary for a deterministic pixel mutation.
